import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.nn.functional as F
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from transformers import LlamaConfig, LlamaForCausalLM
from pipeline_parallel import train_step_pipeline_afab
def main(rank, ws):
    os.environ.update(MASTER_ADDR="127.0.0.1", MASTER_PORT="29533")
    dist.init_process_group("gloo", rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    cfg = LlamaConfig(vocab_size=128, hidden_size=64, intermediate_size=128, num_hidden_layers=5, num_attention_heads=4, num_key_value_heads=2)
    ref = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg); model = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg); model.load_state_dict(ref.state_dict())
    inputs = [torch.randint(0,128,(2,16)) for _ in range(4)]; targets = [torch.randint(0,128,(2,16)) for _ in range(4)]
    loss = train_step_pipeline_afab(model, inputs, targets, torch.device("cpu"), torch.float32)
    rl = 0
    for i,t in zip(inputs,targets):
        l = F.cross_entropy(ref(i).logits.reshape(-1,128), t.reshape(-1))/4; l.backward(); rl += l.item()
    maxd = 0; n = 0
    for (k,p),(_,q) in zip(model.named_parameters(), ref.named_parameters()):
        if p.grad is not None:
            n += 1; maxd = max(maxd, (p.grad-q.grad).abs().max().item())
    print(rank, "loss", loss, rl, "params w/ grad", n, "maxdiff", maxd)
    dist.destroy_process_group()
if __name__ == "__main__":
    ws = int(sys.argv[1]); torch.multiprocessing.spawn(main, args=(ws,), nprocs=ws)
EOF
